current_date: 2026-02-04 (Cabinet adopted the Revised Local Validation Checklist, per the democracy decision page; the PDF could not be read to confirm Grokbot's 'Updated October 2026')
current_evidence: The council's 'Planning advice note and validation checklists' page links 'Local validation checklist' (645 KB) to this exact PDF, alongside a 'Requirements matrix'. Cabinet adopted the Revised Local Validation Checklist on 4 Feb 2026 (democracy.bcpcouncil.gov.uk decision AIId=20562), and no newer list or consultation is mentioned.

issues.detail: Many app-type rows contradict or misapply their own source. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' is placed under Householder (and Change of use prior approval), but the quoted text says householder development is exempt. Advertisement consent gets Arboricultural, Ecology, EIA, Fire Statement, FRA and DAS rows taken from the combined 'Planning Permission and Consent to display advertisements' checklist; those belong to the planning permission element, not advert consent. LBC gets an FRA row from the 'Householder and Listed Building' checklist. Permission in principle rows come from the Technical-Details-Consent checklist (stage 2), not PiP. Change of use prior approval rows come from the Demolition checklist, the 'New dwellinghouses on detached blocks of flats' checklist and the agricultural-building checklist, none of which are change-of-use prior approvals. Outline rows come from the Reserved Matters checklist. Separately, 29 Full planning rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'.
issues.evidence: Householder row trigger: 'The Sequential Test is required for all sites in Flood Zones 2 & 3, except where: is a householder development like residential extensions...'; Outline row source: Application-for-Reserved-Matters-following-outline-approval-Checklist.pdf.

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are tick-list bleed, page furniture or cut-off fragments instead of a 'when required' trigger. Householder FRA: 'Correct fee Flood Risk Assessment Heritage Asset Statement Further guidance...'. Householder Ventilation: '...28 Appendices 29 Appendix 1: Matrix (inserted as a A3 PDF) 30 Appendix 2...'. Ecology (Full): 'by it Bat survey if meet criteria Based on Development Type'. Drainage/SuDS: 'link to drainage strategy where appropriate.'. Design and Access Statement: 'A Design and Access Statement is required for the below applications;' (cut off, no list). Planning Obligations: 'will require a S106 agreement.'. Transport: 'lost 26 Transport Statement and assessments When required...' (purpose text, no threshold). Retail: NPPF town-centre-first policy text, no floorspace threshold. The EIA, Fire Statement and DAS rows for adverts, demolition in CA and PiP all reuse the same tick-list string.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows excerpts as quoted (source Local-validation-checklist.pdf and type-specific checklists).

issues.detail: Several rows carry text from a different requirement. 'Ground investigation / Geotechnical' contains the Lighting Assessment trigger. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' contains Arboricultural Method Statement text, identical to the Arboricultural row. 'Floor plans / Elevations' (Full) contains cycle store text. 'Roof plan' starts with 'All plans and documents must be submitted in PDF format. 11 Roof Plans...'. 'Highways / access details' is a site-plan content list ('e) All public rights of way... f) The position of all trees...').
issues.evidence: Geotechnical row: '...TCC9 FCERM Background Paper June 2024 Lighting Assessment For major developments; or schemes involving the provision of floodlighting...'

issues.detail: Requirements the council's own materials show but Grokbot has no row for (not checked against the full list text, which could not be fetched). Heritage Asset Statement appears in the Householder, LBC, demolition-in-CA and advert checklist excerpts, yet there is no Heritage Statement row for any app type, including LBC. Coastal Vulnerability Assessment and Geotechnical Appraisal Report have templates on the validation page but no Coastal Vulnerability row. The BNG checklist/self-build proforma and the Biodiversity checklist ('If in mapped zone') have no Householder or Full planning row. Grokbot also did not read the 'Requirements matrix', which maps each requirement to application types.
issues.evidence: Validation page links: 'Coastal vulnerability assessment template, including geotechnical appraisal report template'; 'Requirements matrix' (Matrix.pdf); LBC checklist excerpt: 'Design and Access Statement Heritage Asset Statement Tick Local Requirements...'

issues.detail: Most tab_items are contact details, process text, national rules or fragments: 'These can be emailed to planning@bcpcouncil.gov.uk.' (contact); 'The Council are no longer accepting paper copies...' and 'Our pre-application service will help you...' (process); 'A copy of the notice should be sent with the application... serve notice on the husband/wife/partner' (national ownership-certificate rule); 'Matrix (inserted as a A3 PDF) 30 Appendix 2:' (page fragment); 'Further information regarding mitigation, including how to purchase credits...' (signpost); 'Some local planning authorities also have their own nutrient neutrality calculators... The nutrient neutrality calculators are for:' (fragment); 'River Avon SAC Poole Harbour Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) When required If the site is in the;' (two items merged, cut off); 'Proposals accompanied by an Environmental Statement ... 37 38 Forms 39 ...' (page fragment); 'Commencing development ... could result in enforcement action' (warning).
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules', 'Local forms / checklists' and 'Policy-driven requirements' sections.

issues.detail: 61 app-type rows come from type-specific checklists under /documents/planning-and-building-control/ (e.g. Householder-Validation-Checklist.pdf, Technical-Details-Consent.pdf). The current validation page does not link these; it links only the Local validation checklist, the Requirements matrix and templates. They may predate the revised checklist adopted 4 Feb 2026 and could not be confirmed as current.
issues.evidence: Validation page links: Local-validation-checklist.pdf, Planning-advice-note/Matrix.pdf, coastal vulnerability template, BNG checklist, Biodiversity checklist, geotechnical requirements, BNG guidance; no per-application-type checklists.

issues.detail: Duplicated entries: 'All plans and documents must be submitted in PDF format.' appears twice in tab_items. The Arboricultural and Schedule of works rows (Full) are identical. The Outline and Reserved matters rows (EIA, Fire Statement, Block plan, Elevations) are identical, all from the RM checklist. The same Block plan and Elevations boilerplate is repeated under 10 application types.
issues.evidence: tab_items Submission rules; app_type_rows Outline vs Reserved matters.

summary: Grokbot's link is the PDF the BCP validation page currently links (checklist adopted Feb 2026), but the PDF and the committee appendices could not be fetched, so the contents were not checked against the source. Grokbot's own data still shows serious problems: app types that contradict the quoted text (e.g. Sequential Test placed under Householder despite the householder exemption), rows carrying the wrong requirement's text, mostly non-requirement tab_items, and no Heritage Asset Statement row.
